THE PROBLEM WITH MOST ADS

Most Ads Get Skipped in Seconds. That’s Your Money Scrolling Away.

You pay to put your ad in front of people—and they swipe past before your message even lands. And making a “real” video ad the traditional way means cameras, actors, locations, and a production bill that can run into the thousands.

Traditional Video Ad
Camera crew, actors, and locations
Weeks of planning and production
Thousands of dollars per ad
Still gets skipped if the story is boring
AI Micro-Drama Ad
No camera, no actors, no crew
Created in days with AI tools
A fraction of the cost
A cliffhanger story people want to finish

People don’t skip a story they need to see the end of.

Alicia Lyttle brings more than 20 years of experience in digital transformation, business innovation, and technology to her work as an AI educator. As CEO and Co-Founder of AI Innovision, a Certified AI Consultant, and a TEDx speaker, she helps entrepreneurs, corporations, nonprofits, and more move beyond AI buzzwords and understand how to put the tools to work.

Her training spans AI strategy, automation, avatars, and micro-drama video production. In AI Micro Drama Ads Academy, she brings that practical focus to storytelling: finding the idea, shaping the script, choosing the tools, and bringing the scenes to life. The goal is to help you understand the creative process, not just admire the finished video.
